phrases.latin: Postquam rotae cum sonitū terram tetigērunt, āëroplanum sēnsim tardius currēns tandem cōnstitit.
phrases.english: When the wheels had touched the ground with a thud, the plane, running ever more slowly, at last stopped.

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency: p. 217, checked against the searchable text of the book on 29 October 2026; p. 337.
